accepted_no_u_state.u_RS_policy: Report repeat/refinement uncertainty separately; do not add it to A2 primary allowance absent user-approved interpretation.

locked_models_and_checks.E_num_basis: For a raw-minus-shifted SUMEV response, propagate two per-case 1e-8 Ry ENERGY_TOL guards; applicable only to A3 control eligibility/comparison and not added to the A2 model allowance.
locked_models_and_checks.allowance: A_RS=sum_s abs(r_fit,s(t_s/q0_s))+D0_RS; D0_RS is added exactly once. This is RS-only; no KS fit/floor imported. Report u_RS separately.
locked_models_and_checks.fit: Unweighted signed cubic r_fit(v)=a0+a1*v+a2*v^2+a3*v^3 on all 14 points, using the same A2.2 mathematical fit model; the RS-specific capture validator checks frozen-array/map provenance. Report signed quadratic and leave-one-magnitude-out/linear sensitivity only as diagnostics.
locked_models_and_checks.new_response_predictions: No new six-shift response values are predicted; lock the model, measured-shift set, shape checks and allowance formula before those responses. U2 M0.3 controls must have a separate A3 preregistration from the captured RS U2 state before any U2 radial response.
locked_models_and_checks.no_u_gate: If shape checks fail or actual U2 shifts exceed +/-0.12 Ry, stop RS M0.3 before radial U2 response.
locked_models_and_checks.shape_checks: Reuse A2.2 checks: constant nonzero sign within each signed branch; |r| strictly decreases toward zero as |v| halves; all-point log|r| versus log|v| OLS order >=2; |a0|<=10*D0_RS. Exact zero means log order unassessed and stop for review.

new_shift_responses.frozen_state: Use the complete accepted per-stage RAW_PL snapshot from iteration 2: m0_replay_rofi, v_input, rho_input, EC/EV seeds, PL tuple inputs and returns, QL inputs, radial parameters, and order-indexed controls. Verify all existing A1_SHIFT_01..08 snapshots match RAW_PL exactly for every frozen input; only the d-shell PL center and its separately captured center-shift control may differ. Rehydrate only this RAW_PL time level (never generic RADIAL_REPLAY/LIVE_STATE arrays). Require exact A1 RAW q0/q2 identity and RAW_PL zero-anchor PL/rho/SUMEC/SUMEV reproduction under existing driver guards before accepting new shifts. Each response changes only the center shift and preserves captured q0/q2 and all other arrays. Run a standalone zero-shift RAW_PL anchor first and inspect its complete replay guards; do not invoke the six-shift response driver unless that anchor passes.

production_replay_driver.method: Read accepted base plus eight existing A1 rows from immutable capture; run one zero-shift anchor and six preregistered shifts through this exact production calculate_pl/NEWRHO fixture driver. The zero-shift anchor must reproduce accepted frozen state before any six-shift response is used. The zero-shift anchor is also available as a separate fail-closed preflight; six shifts run only after it passes. Radial selectors are bound to the accepted run log: TXC=1 and F core check:0.
production_replay_driver.source_snapshot_rationale: The fixture driver was built from the immutable M0 source snapshot; the live repository source has since advanced for M1. Verify calculate_pl source against that bound immutable snapshot, not the mutable checkout.

runtime_selector_binding.basis: The accepted production run log reports XC selector TXC=1; fixture rehydration uses that exact selector. A prior anchor-only attempt with TXC=0 stopped at SETXCP before any shift response and is retained as a rejected diagnostic at /private/tmp/a3-rs-a22-scalar-scan/raw_anchor.stdout.log.

radial_f_core_binding.evidence: The accepted no-U run log reports `F core check:0`; the replay adapter uses that captured selector, not the count of core seed rows.

scope: Separate non-blocking RS M0 under A2/A3; this scalar calibration is only the no-U response model preregistration and does not claim an RS U2 M0 result.
